consequence.statement: Existing ImagePolicy objects remain stored as v1beta2 until rewritten; a storage version migration must be run and status.storedVersions updated before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all ImagePolicy objects (storage version migration) and update status.storedVersions on the CRD.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the imagepolicies.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD changes from v1beta2 to v1, so existing ImagePolicy objects stay stored as v1beta2 until a storage version migration is run.
